news.title: International grads three times more likely to find work in Germany
news.summary_en: New report argues Germany’s universities are increasingly functioning as skilled migration infrastructure amid mounting STEM shortages and growing pressure to retain international graduates.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: International education at the heart of UK-China collaboration
news.summary_en: The inaugural UK-China Business Awards highlighted the increasingly important role that international education plays in shaping the future of relations between the two countries.
news.author: Rongrong Walker

news.title: BCA blind spot as admin review backlog reaches six months
news.summary_en: An apparent blind spot in visa processing that could impact university RAG ratings has emerged as international students are encouraged to dispute visa decisions through the administrative review process, potentially exempting them from BCA calculations.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert

news.title: My CEO story: Tzvetelina Ivova, SRT Fairs
news.summary_en: The PIE sat down with Tzvetelina Ivova, CEO and founder of SRT Fairs, about why she decided to start her business and how Gen Z is changing student fair dynamics.
news.author: The PIE News team

news.title: Germany risks weakening academic ties with global south
news.summary_en: DAAD says planned BMZ funding cuts could undermine Germany’s scientific influence, skilled worker pipeline and long-term university networks.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Pakistan broadens TNE eligibility under new reforms
news.summary_en: New HEC framework expands access for specialist institutions, formalises dual and joint degree programs and tightens oversight of international collaborations.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: The PIE investigates: the real cost of non-refundable deposits
news.summary_en: After UK visa rejection rates soared over the winter, thousands of students from countries like Pakistan and Bangladesh are now being told their tuition fee deposits are non-refundable. The PIE investigates the scale of the problem and how refund policies are being communicated by universities and agents.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert

news.title: What New Zealand’s levy reveals about England’s international student recruitment model
news.summary_en: As conversations around England's upcoming international student levy intensify, Vincenzo Raimo looks across the world to an existing model that's been in place for decades.
news.author: Vincenzo Raimo

news.title: International students must leave US to apply for green card, says USCIS
news.summary_en: New US government policy guidance could significantly restrict international students and workers applying for permanent residency on American soil.
news.author: Polly Nash
